author: Battlezone
quote:
Don't get me wrong, the graphics are amazing and the game looks very nice graphics-wise. However, I really couldn't get myself to enjoy the gameplay.
It just didn't feel like a GTA game to me, and it felt more like a GTA RP server.
I also encountered a few glitches, mostly when driving fast with a vehicle (vehicle stopping suddenly and colliding with invisible objects, vehicle starting to freak out when idle, vehicle elongating like a rubber band. and a few other instances)
 The main character Jason is very boring and uninteresting. The missions were very average and I could expect them from a random indie GTA knockoff.
I think if the script was more interesting (something at the level of breaking bad for example), and if there was less boring chores and fillers, the game would have hit the mark for me and it would have been a 9/10. I'm really devastated that I had to wait 13 years only to get disappointed. The game wasn't cheap either, so I took a small financial hit for it.
